KICK PEOPLE
-----------
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").AdminPanelEvents.Kick:FireServer("username")
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
KICK ALL
--------
for i,v in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
   game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").AdminPanelEvents.Kick:FireServer(v.Name)
end

KILL PEOPLE
----------

Infinite points
------------
